dogecoin.text:
Token Supply: The Core of Scarcity

Max Supply (Sₘₐₓ): Total tokens that will ever exist.

- Bitcoin: 21M  
- Dogecoin: Infinite  

Circulating Supply (S꜀): Tokens actively trading. 

(Formula: S꜀ = Total Minted – Burned – Locked Tokens)

What are ALTCOINS?
Any crypto except Bitcoin.
 
Examples: $ETH, $ADA, $DOGE.  

Purpose: Fix Bitcoin’s flaws or enable new use cases: 
 
- Smart contracts  
- Privacy (Monero)  
- Cross-chain (Polkadot)  
- Lower fees & faster speeds .
